who.value: any app user on the home feed

job.value: Browse the home feed and notice a service-category promo beside the hero banner

arrivedFrom.value: opening the For you home tab

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The home tabs, 'Live shows' and category icons read as the familiar home feed.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The orange 'Reliable Service. Unbeatable Price.' half-banner is noticeable, but the clipped left banner ('Carousell al Delivery', 'Women fashi') competes and looks broken.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Category icons ('Likes', 'Mobile Phones') and 'See all' predict, but the split banners have no CTA and the left one's cut-off text doesn't say where it goes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Terms are familiar home-feed words; 'Live' with viewer counts is standard.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Browsing requires no decisions the person can't make.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Promo detail is behind the banner tap.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A services promo next to a fashion/delivery banner and TCG live shows is a mix of audiences, which is intended but dilutes both.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The half-width banners squeeze their headline text small; the left one's copy is truncated so it can't be read at all.
